name: hypr-hands
description: Omarchy UI Helper: Grok Bot skills + scripts for driving Omarchy/Hyprland (Wayland) desktops remotely - observe, point, click, scroll, drag, type, read the screen and manage windows, plus Cua Driver and Omarchy skills. Install the Grok Bot desktop app first, since some Omarchy versions don't preinstall it: ask your Omarchy default agent to fetch the official Linux .deb and install it with pacman, then press Ctrl+Super+G to open it.
